protocol.single_stage: LightGBM multiclass, 11 labels, argmax; no separate gate
protocol.matched_comparator: binary LightGBM screening plus unchanged Jaccard 1-NN, on exactly the same closed-catalog development rows and fold-specific features
protocol.training_eligibility: all controls plus unambiguous positives in the ten-family alphabet; exclude Xenobiotics/ambiguous positives, not relabel them as controls
protocol.split: archived outer split and archived five development folds, intersected with eligible rows
protocol.feature_selection: binary training-positive gene union, identical GO terms/features in both matched methods per fold; no heldout feature selection
protocol.threshold: matched binary: original maximum-balanced-accuracy rule on grouped development OOF only; original deployed threshold unchanged
protocol.primary_endpoint: 11-label end-to-end macro-F1 on same 169 eligible heldout rows; accuracy/weighted-F1 complementary
protocol.uncertainty: paired group-bootstrap, 2000 draws seed42, identical groups, fixed fits/decisions; zero for absent fixed labels
protocol.method_selection: fixed protocol; do not adopt an architecture or threshold based on holdout outcome
protocol.limitations: exploratory comparison on previously consulted holdout; multiclass objective produces more trees per boosting round; comparison is one specific baseline, not proof of universal architecture necessity
